questions.prompt: Which beginning-of-construction date should govern: off-site transformer manufacture from December 22, 2025, or on-site pile work from January 12, 2026?
questions.context: Seller relies on off-site physical work on a custom main power transformer under a binding contract dated December 10, 2025. That work is supported only by the manufacturer's letter, which the independent engineer has not reviewed. The independent engineer verified on-site work beginning January 12, 2026; the December 18, 2025 notice to proceed is not physical work. The answer decides two things. First, the domestic content threshold: 47.8% passes 45% for a 2025 start but fails 50% for a 2026 start. Second, whether the foreign entity material assistance rules apply; the module certification and cost ratio are still missing. Amounts below assume the revised $136,400,000 basis and that the apprenticeship shortfall is cured.
